_comment: Every analytic judgment the 2026 edition makes, in one file. Each entry is a provisional choice the author must confirm or change (docs/VERIFY_CHECKLIST.md, section 'Judgment calls'). Change a value here and re-run code/02 onward; nothing else hard-codes these.

dedup.why: v1.1 ingested the ICS Advisory Project Master file AND the per-year files; the Master file is a superset, so every pair appears twice. Keeping only Master rows restores one row per pair.

scope.why: An advisory is ONG-relevant if CISA tags it Energy (the sector that contains oil and natural gas) or 'oil and gas', or if the v1.1 taxonomy maps the product to an ONG process-control class. It is US-relevant if CISA's distribution field includes the US, worldwide or an unspecified multi-country footprint.
scope.exclude_why: EV-charging platforms, chargers and charge-management systems carry CISA's Energy tag but are not oil and natural gas OT. A 2026 wave of them (13 advisories) would otherwise inflate the ONG count. Matched on advisory title or vendor; excluded advisories are counted in build_log.json.

windows.why: The input snapshot's last advisory release date is 2026-09-10, so every year is compared on the same 1 Jan - 10 Sep window. Full-year counts are shown for 2012-2025 only.

priority_tiers.tier2: not KEV, but CISA SSVC Exploitation is 'active' or 'poc', or EPSS percentile >= tier2_epss_percentile
priority_tiers.tier3: no exploitation evidence, advisory severity Critical
priority_tiers.why: Exploitation evidence first (KEV, then SSVC/EPSS), severity second - the ordering CISA's own KEV/SSVC guidance implies. Thresholds are the author's.

mega_advisory_why: A few advisories (third-party component roll-ups) list hundreds of CVEs. Counts are reported with and without advisories above this many CVEs so one roll-up cannot drive a year-over-year change.
